data.name: optoData.mat
data.attribution: Grier, Harrison; Salimian, Sohrab; Kaufman, Matthew T. (2025). Data from Mouse sensorimotor cortex reflects complex kinematic details during reaching and grasping. figshare.

native_fields_to_declared_endpoint.trialNumber: trial_number, native positive integer, unique within animal and timestamp
native_fields_to_declared_endpoint.grabTimeC: native timestamp in milliseconds, no waterTime subtraction
native_fields_to_declared_endpoint.liftTimeC: native timestamp in milliseconds, no waterTime subtraction

clock_lineage.paper_semantics: Cue tone and water delivery occur simultaneously.
clock_lineage.other_primary_code_semantics: preproc/loadEventTimes.m lines22-23 subtract waterTime from grabTimeC for contact reaction times. This function handles the imaging event summaries; it does not change the opto plot code.
clock_lineage.inference: Unshifted native contact timestamps cannot be assumed to be cue-relative latency; source plot label conflicts with released clock lineage.

scope: Independent native population and clock admission; no replacement ingestion adapter, endpoint export, new scorer or solver trial
preserved_gates: Resolve source plot versus water-relative event-clock interpretation without silently changing the frozen endpoint
